hypothesis: The remaining failure after removing the supplied temporal integrator is primarily hard-quantization error. A compact two-stage residual discrete code should preserve enough state for a generic learned local spatiotemporal law to extrapolate without receiving the Laplacian, wave-speed labels, or velocity-Verlet update.

learned_transition.local_features: full 3x3 neighborhood of both state channels (18 features)
learned_transition.per_training_sequence_map: ridge least-squares one-step map from 18 local features to the next 2-channel state
learned_transition.family_learning: PCA over flattened per-sequence 2x18 maps; use mean plus top 12 principal directions
learned_transition.latent_inference: ridge least squares from the two observed context transitions
learned_transition.rollout: generic one-step local linear state-space map; recursive; requantize through both residual-VQ stages after every predicted step

frozen_pass_rule: PASS only if every one of the 3 fresh transition-training/evaluation replicates has requantized rollout MSE ratio < 1.0 versus raw-state persistence on ID h8, spectrum-OOD h3, and combined-OOD h3. No retry or replacement of a failed replicate. Reconstruction NMSE and latent diagnostics are secondary and cannot rescue failure.
claim_limit: A pass would show that a hierarchical discrete state representation plus a learned local low-rank spatiotemporal family can extrapolate in this synthetic wave system without the exact spatial law, speed labels, or known temporal integrator. Locality, linearity, and low-rank family structure remain supplied priors; this is not unrestricted scientific-law discovery.
